title: Cartwise+ Membership Pause Allowance
content:
The pause allowance of a Cartwise+ Membership is the plan's longest pause, as set in the plan's pause terms, counted in calendar days with the next renewal date as the first paused day. The pause length booked for a member who asks for the longest pause available is the pause allowance in whole days, and never below the plan's shortest pause.

## Reading the allowance

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Unit | whole calendar days |
| Counting starts | on the next renewal date, which is the first paused day |
| Amount | the plan's longest pause from the plan's pause terms |
| Floor | the plan's shortest pause from the plan's pause terms |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A plan whose longest pause is 90 days and shortest pause is 14 days; the current period ends 20 July.

- Pause allowance: 90 days.
- Pause length: 90 days, which is not below 14.
- First paused day: 20 July. Last paused day: 20 July plus 89 days, which is 17 October.

A plan whose longest pause is 60 days, with the current period ending 3 February: pause length 60 days, first paused day 3 February, last paused day 3 February plus 59 days, which is 3 April in a non-leap year.
